title: Iterated first projection is polynomial-time
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb{N}$, the $n$-fold iterate of the total first projection on bit strings is polynomial-time computable; the zeroth iterate is the identity function.
replaced: Let $\pi_1$ be the total first projection, which sends a bit string of the form $\langle a,b\rangle$ (the self-delimiting pair encoding: every bit of $a$ doubled, then $01$, then $b$) to $a$ and any other bit string to the empty word. For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the $n$-fold iterate $\pi_1^{n} = \pi_1 \circ \cdots \circ \pi_1$ (the identity for $n = 0$), which extracts the root of a left-nested tuple, is polynomial-time computable.
